_comment: NEXORA devnet parameters (Phase 2). Single source of truth for ci/phase2/*.sh. DEVNET ONLY - not mainnet, not a public network. Reversible: nothing here modifies the upstream reference code.
bech32_note: Kept as upstream 'cosmos' on purpose: changing the SDK bech32 prefix is a code-level change in the reference binary and is out of Phase 2 scope (config-only phase).

fees._note: evmd's feemarket initial base fee is 1 gwei = 1e9 anex per gas and decays across blocks, so 2e9 anex/gas is used to always clear the current base fee. Observed requirement in the first blocks: ~448795318 anex/gas (see docs/phase2-report.md).
fees._feemarket_note: eth_gasPrice returned 0x0 because feemarket min_gas_price was 0, so the EIP-1559 base fee decayed to nothing and every transaction was free. evm_base_fee is the starting base fee (2 gwei); evm_base_fee_floor is what it decays TOWARD (1 gwei), so gas is never zero. ci/phase3/gen4-genesis.sh writes both into genesis.
fees._min_gas_price_fix: Corrected from '0anex'. The genesis feemarket module already set min_gas_price to 1 gwei, so the two disagreed and the params file was the one that was wrong. This value is passed to evmd as --minimum-gas-prices, so leaving it at zero made the documented single source of truth permit free transactions even though the chain rejects them. Verified: cast rpc eth_gasPrice returns ~1.13 gwei on a live chain. A non-zero floor is mandatory before any public network - see docs/MAINNET-READINESS-REPORT.md section 2.

upstream_keys.source: Parsed at runtime from the upstream, unmodified /tmp/cosmos-evm/local_node.sh (public upstream test mnemonics). No key material is stored in this repository.

_chain_id_note: EIP-155 format so wallets and tooling that expect eip155:<id> recognise this chain. The numeric id matches evm_chain_id (902024 / 0xdc388). Changing this regenerates genesis and invalidates all prior state.
_denom_symbol_note: The chain denomination is the base unit "anex" (lowercase, that is the on-chain denom). The DISPLAY symbol shown to wallets is ANEX. "NEX" was the earlier placeholder and never appeared on chain; the genesis accounts carry anex. Wallet UIs show whatever symbol the user types, so docs and wallets use ANEX consistently.
